Needs changes before merge.

The trial merge with upstream/main (31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239) is clean. The image command, page links, alt text, and image limits passed the local checks. I inspected all 13 committed images.

Local results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; six steps planned. This was a plan check, not a gate run.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 140 unit tests and 10 integration tests passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed on retry. The first build ended with exit 143 without a compiler error.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 849 passed; seven ignored.
- The explicit off-screen guide render test: one passed; all 13 PNGs were written to `/tmp`.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_images.py`: three passed, including the Zola build and image URL check.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/guide_projects.rs:230` and `:241`: correct or explain the unsafe multi-axis examples. The committed `Indexed Face1` path has 30 gouge warnings (`examples/guide-multiaxis.camproj:6464`). `Swarf1` has 897 shank-hit, nine rapid-in-stock, and two sweep-hit warnings (`examples/guide-multiaxis.camproj:38238`). The guide embeds these paths as operation examples at `site/content/guide/multi-axis/indexed.md:70` and `site/content/guide/multi-axis/operations-multiaxis.md:162`, without an explanation of the unsafe state. The Swarf image shows red paths. Adjust the demo geometry or settings to remove these safety warnings, regenerate the images, and add assertions that reject these warnings in normal examples. If these are intended to show unsafe paths, clearly identify them as unsafe examples and explain the warnings and required corrections beside each image.

Safety checks and notes:

- The new geometry is demo geometry. The PR does not change the production post, collision, gouge, or stock simulation algorithms. No NC, CL, or release snapshot goldens moved.
- I repeated two reported mutations on temporary source copies. With `MIN_WIDTH` changed from 1000 to 1, the narrow-image test failed. With the alt-word check changed from `<= 4` to `== 999_999`, the short-alt test failed. All three unit tests passed on the unchanged copy. The review worktree source was not changed.
- The generated demo project values match the committed values except for the project format version, which current main updates from 61 to 62.
- The `crates/ui` changes add test modules only. They do not change the production UI layout.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed the latest review finding using the explained unsafe-example option.

- Indexed Face1: the image and adjacent note now identify the unsafe example, explain its 30 gouge warnings, and require tilted-plane, cut-depth and boundary corrections before regeneration and verification.
- Swarf1: the image and adjacent note now identify the unsafe red paths, explain the 897 shank-hit, 9 rapid-in-stock and 2 sweep-hit warnings, and describe tool, stock, pose, clearance and retract corrections. Both notes say do not post or machine these examples.

Pinned by `GuideImagesTest.test_unsafe_multiaxis_images_explain_cached_warnings_and_corrections`. The test checks the adjacent notes against the committed demo warning counts. Reverting each page separately made the test fail. Restoring each fix made it pass.

The four Python guide tests, including Zola, passed. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. `cargo clippy -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

New head: 9526b88ade470d90e5ce6a2cbb487f7f7d288b8f

Please re-review. The PR remains a draft.

Needs changes before merge.

The trial merge with upstream/main at `31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239` was clean.

The earlier safety finding is resolved. Both multi-axis images now have an adjacent note that identifies the unsafe example, gives the cached warning counts, and specifies corrections. Both notes say do not post or machine. The new test checks these notes against the saved project. I inspected all 13 guide images.

Local results on the trial merge:

- `cargo test -p xtask`: 140 unit tests and 10 integration tests passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 849 passed; seven ignored.
- The explicit off-screen guide render test: one passed. It wrote 13 images and the demo projects to `/tmp`.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_images.py -v`: four passed, including the Zola build and the safety-note check.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The quick gate dry run passed. This was a plan check, not a full gate run.

Requested before merge:

1. `xtask/src/main.rs:15` and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION:1`: increment the process version in this PR. The PR adds a command under `xtask/`, but it does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The version is still 76, the same as the reviewed main base. The root AGENTS.md rule, "Process changes bump PROCESS_VERSION", and review-prs step 2d require this bump so forks receive the new process tool.

Safety checks and notes:

- This PR adds demo geometry. It does not change production geometry, posting, gouge checks, collision checks, or stock simulation logic. No NC, CL, or release snapshot goldens moved.
- I repeated two reported mutations on temporary source copies. Setting `MIN_WIDTH` to 1 made `narrow_png_width_is_refused` fail. Changing the alt-word check from `<= 4` to `== 999_999` made `short_alt_text_is_refused` fail. All three unit tests passed on the unchanged source before and after these checks.
- I also reverted each multi-axis page fix in memory, one at a time. Each revert made the new safety-note test fail. The test passed with both fixes present.
- The PR changes only test modules under `crates/ui`. It does not change the production UI, so UI before/after review screenshots are not required for this change. The guide images are the product documentation assets requested in issue #1902.
- No PR code was changed. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The latest review requests one change: bump `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` for the new xtask command.

That change contradicts AGENTS.md on this head and current upstream/main. Lines 143–152 say a process PR must not edit PROCESS_VERSION. Its body must contain `Process change: yes`. The merging session owns the bump after a merge batch. This PR body already contains the required line.

Please re-review or withdraw this finding under the current rule. I did not change PROCESS_VERSION or push a commit. The head remains 9526b88ade470d90e5ce6a2cbb487f7f7d288b8f. No new pin, mutation check, gate or clippy run applies because no fix was made. The conflicts label remains; I stopped before a merge refresh because the sole requested fix is explicitly prohibited by the author-side instructions.

The latest review requests one change: increment `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

I cannot apply it under the author-side instruction to never touch that file. AGENTS.md on the current head, lines 143–152, also assigns the bump to the merging session and prohibits it in this PR. The PR body already contains `Process change: yes`.

Please re-review or withdraw this finding under that rule. No files changed and no commit was pushed. Head remains `9526b88ade470d90e5ce6a2cbb487f7f7d288b8f`. Pins, mutation checks, gate and clippy were not run because no fix was made. The conflict refresh was not performed; the conflicts label remains unchanged.
